parameters.description: Head turn; + = toward the screen right (more profile), - = toward the viewer.
Head pitch; + = looks up.
Head tilt; + = clockwise (crown toward the screen right).
0 = closed (lid line), 1 = open.
Happy eye: open -> "◠" squint, closed -> "∩" arc.
Surprise: the eye grows (and the ring a little).
Gaze; + = toward the screen right.
Gaze; + = up.
Brow height; + = raised, - = lowered. The brow shows only when used.
Brow angle; - = angry/determined (lowered toward the beak), + = worried/sad.
Beak opening (lower mandible rotates down). Rev2D lip sync drives it.
Smile line; + = bigger smile, - = frown.
Blush on the face patch.
Inhale: chest swells, head and wings rise.
Body turn; + = toward the screen right.
Lean about the hips (degrees, + = clockwise); the feet stay planted.
Squash (+) and stretch (-) about the feet.
Whole-body position, px; + = screen right.
Whole-body height, px; - = up (jumps, flight). The shadow stays on the ground.
Contact shadow opacity (0 hides it).
Near wing: 0 folded; + raises it up-left (cheer, flap); -1 points forward (right); -1.5 covers the face.
Near wing opens: folded -> spread feathers.
Near wing tip curls in (holding objects).
Far wing: 0 folded behind the body; + raises it up-right.
Far wing opens.
Tail swing (physics output: do not animate).
Tail up (+) / down (-).
Tail feathers fan out.
Near foot, px; + = screen right.
Near foot, px; - = lifted.
Far foot, px; + = screen right.
Far foot, px; - = lifted.
Feet tucked up and back (flight).

bones.description: Fixed world anchor on the ground line (never animated).
Carries the contact shadow: follows BodyX, shrinks with height.
Whole-body translation (BodyX, BodyY) and squash & stretch about the feet.
Carries the wings and the neck; lifts with each breath.
Upper mandible; follows the face warp at the hinge.
Lower mandible; MouthOpen rotates it down.

warps.description: Whole head: gentle pseudo-3D turn of the outline.
Face patch, eye ring and brow: stronger turn than the outline.
The eye and its highlights: gaze and surprise.

parts.description: Soft contact shadow: stacked translucent ellipses (each subpath is filled on its own, so they build up toward the centre).
Far (left) wing: behind the body, its leading edge shows along the chest.
Far wing coverts (visible when the wing is raised).
Far foot: pad + back toe + two front toes.
Near foot: pad + back toe + two front toes.
Torso, chest and thighs (one shape).
Shade on the far thigh.
Lighter feather edges on the chest.
Near (right) wing: flight feathers (the coverts are drawn on top).
Near wing coverts: lighter, with a scalloped lower edge.
Rounded nape feathers along the back of the neck.
Head feathers (the face patch and beak cover the front).
Light on the crown (same outline as the head, fading out with the gradient).
Soft feather edges on the back of the head.
Bare white face patch (clipped to the head, so it never pokes out when the face turns).
Blush on the face patch (Blush parameter).
Bright ring around the eye.
The black eye (morphs for blinks and expressions).
Brow stroke, only visible when BrowRY / BrowRAngle are used.
Mouth interior: a hidden sliver when closed, follows the jaw when open.
Lower mandible.
Hooked upper mandible.

bindings.description: Looking up tips the beak up.
The head shifts a little toward the turn.
Beak hinge stays on the turning face.
Beak hinge stays on the turning face.
The upper mandible lifts a little.
Open, the interior is the dark gap; the line fades.
